For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Krishna Pd. Singh, Sr. Adv  Mr. Shankar Dayal Singh, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Brajendra Nath Pandey, APP

======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY  ORAL ORDER 7 12-11-2024 Heard Mr. Krishna Prasad Singh, learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner and the State.

2. The petitioner is in judicial custody in connection with Murar P.S. Case No. 41 of 2023 for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 409/34 of the IPC, lodged on 23.04.2023 by the informant,
Chaitanya Singh.

3. As per the prosecution story, the informant alleged that the petitioner approached the informant with a proposal of sale of paddy crops at the rate of Rs. 2042/- per quintal and thereafter, for 17130 Kgs paddy worth Rs. 3,49,452/-, he paid Rs. 1,09,452/- but chose not to pay the rest of the amount of Rs. 2,40,000/-.
He had intention to cheat from the beginning and as such, the cheque given by him was not encashed, this led to the Patna High Court CR.
Learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner submits that due to confusion, the case has been lodged, he was always ready to make the payment and the initial payment was also made.

Further, if granted relief, he would be clearing the amount in the following way:-

1 (i) Rs. 40,000/- at the time of execution of bail bond;
(ii) Rs. 25,000/- each for the next eight months beginning January, 2025 which will to an end in August, 2025 by 10th of every month.
5.

sentences.text: Learned APP, opposes the prayer submitting that he has criminal antecedent.

6. Taking into account the fair submission put forward by learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner as as also that he is ready to pay the amount, in that background, this Court is inclined to extend him the privilege of bail, subject to the conditions that have been undertaken by the learned Senior Counsel which has to be fulfilled by the petitioner.
